name: meanthis
description: Local-first UI reference layer for precise human-to-agent context

scripts.build: npm run verify:version-alignment && npm run build:packages && npm --workspace @meanthis/cli run build && npm --workspace @meanthis/demo-web run build && npm --workspace @meanthis/extension-mv3 run build && npm run verify:examples && npm run verify:package-packs:node22
scripts.build:packages: tsc -b packages/schema packages/prompt packages/web-extractor packages/hub-core packages/web-picker packages/replay tools/source-map-core tools/source-resolver-mcp
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm --workspace @meanthis/cli run build && vitest run --maxWorkers=4
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/schema packages/prompt packages/web-extractor packages/hub-core packages/web-picker packages/replay tools/source-map-core tools/source-resolver-mcp apps/cli apps/demo-web apps/extension-mv3
scripts.build:bridge: npm run build:packages && tsc -b tools/source-map-core tools/source-resolver-mcp apps/cli && npm --workspace @meanthis/cli run verify:cli && npm --workspace @meanthis/cli run verify:bridge-process
scripts.setup:bridge:codex: npm run build:bridge && npm link --workspace @meanthis/cli && meanthis bridge install --host codex --json && meanthis bridge install-native-host --json
scripts.verify:packages: npm run build:packages && npm --workspace @meanthis/cli run build && npm run verify:package-packs:node22
